Ramogi FM - Royal Media Services
Kar Chuny Jaluo.
Ramogi FM, Kenya’s premier Dholuo FM radio station. With its slogan “Kar Chuny Jaluo,” meaning “The desires of the Luo,” Ramogi FM caters to the deep desires of the Luo community. It enjoys the highest reach, affinity, and share of listenership in the Lake Region, transcending urban and rural settings while appealing to individuals of all genders. The station’s programs are specifically tailored to align with Luo identity, addressing their preferences and expectations.
Ramogi FM has successfully blended Luo culture and values with charismatic personalities, offering a diverse mix that captivates its audience. Upholding its mandate for the past 19 years, the station continues to provide exciting programs that transform lives,
educate, inform, and entertain. While its primary target audience is the Luo community, Ramogi FM also appeals to anyone who appreciates and understands Dholuo music, culture, information, and entertainment. The station is a received on the following frequencies Nairobi 107.1FM, Kisumu 107.6 FM, Siaya 98.4 FM, Homabay 97.0FM, Migori 95.4FM and 98.6FM, Mombasa 99.2FM, Nakuru 95.4 FM.

Who we are
Royal Media Services (RMS) is a prominent Kenyan media company that has made a significant impact on the country's media landscape. Founded in 1996 by Dr. S. K. Macharia, RMS has emerged as a leading player in the industry, providing diverse broadcasting platforms and publications to a wide audience.
RMS operates multiple television and stations, allowing it to reach audiences across different regions and linguistic communities in Kenya. Its television stations include Citizen TV, Inooro TV, and others. Citizen TV, in particular, has gained immense popularity and has become one of the most-watched free-to-air TV channels in Kenya.
Ramogi FM serves the Luo-speaking community, Musyi FM broadcasts in the Kamba language, and there are other stations targeting various communities as well. These radio stations play a vital role in disseminating news, information, and entertainment to diverse audiences, contributing to the preservation and promotion of local languages and cultures.

RMS has launched crucial sustainability projects across its media outlets to inform and educate the nation about the great need to protect and conserve the environment. Through this program, RMS aims to heighten awareness and provide public education about the current state of the planet. Our goal is to equip the society with the necessary knowledge and resources to safeguard and conserve the planet for the benefit of future generations.
